# Version 3.119.4
> **Cross-platform maintenance release** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands platform support while fixing rendering and deployment issues across supported runtimes. The release adds Linux Bionic assets, restores legacy .NET Framework targeting, and addresses Android, GTK, tvOS, and Windows reliability.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and additional Tizen assets added** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets and broadens Tizen native build coverage. ([#3698](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3698), [#3685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3685))
- **Legacy .NET Framework targeting restored** — Adds a net48 target for Windows consumers that still require the full .NET Framework. ([#3672](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3672))

## Bug Fixes

- **Rendering and view lifecycle fixes** — Fixes Android MAUI tab rendering, GTK4 Cairo failures, and tvOS device and simulator native packaging. ([#3674](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3674), [#3574](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3574), [#3570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3570), [#3569](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3569))
- **Windows systems without DirectX 12 start safely** — D3D12 is delay-loaded so applications do not fail at startup when the library is unavailable. ([#3653](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3653))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

Updates HarfBuzzSharp with the corresponding native text-shaping maintenance changes.
